query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Process pending invoice emails, persist invoice attachments to cloud storage, update spreadsheet ledgers, verify calculated totals, and label processed messages.
query_ground_truth.query: find pending bill messages and save all attached files
query_ground_truth.rationale: An agent needs to search for and retrieve unread invoice emails, then extract their file attachments for cloud storage upload.

request.query: find pending bill messages and save all attached files

results.use_case: find pending bill messages and save all attached files
results.execution_guidance: Found 4 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Zoho Books handles accounting, invoicing, and expense tracking, offering real-time collaboration and integrations within the Zoho ecosystem
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=zoho_books. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="zoho_books") to create a connection BEFORE executing any zoho_books tools.

ZOHO_BOOKS_GET_BILL_ATTACHMENT.description: Tool to fetch an attachment from a specific bill. Use when you need to download a document attached to a bill.

bill_id.description: Unique identifier of the bill to fetch the attachment from

preview.description: Get the thumbnail of the attachment instead of the full file

ZOHO_BOOKS_GET_BILL.description: Tool to fetch details of a specific bill. Use after confirming the organization context.

bill_id.description: Unique identifier of the bill to fetch

ZOHO_BOOKS_ADD_BILL_ATTACHMENT.description: Tool to add an attachment to an existing bill in Zoho Books. Use when you need to attach a file to a bill.

bill_id.description: Unique identifier of the bill to add the attachment to.

name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

attachment.description: File to attach to the bill. Allowed file types: gif, png, jpeg, jpg, bmp, pdf.

ZOHO_BOOKS_DELETE_BILL_ATTACHMENT.description: Tool to delete an attachment from a specific bill. Use when you need to remove an attached document ...
